subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@finservcorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Hi Samir / Priya —

Great to meet with you earlier today. Thanks for carving out time to walk through the demo and some of the production scenarios you described. Per our conversation, I put together a short recap and a proposed POC plan to help validate Redwood for your use case. The attached PDF is the formal POC plan and I've also added an evaluation checklist (spreadsheet) you can use to score results.

Quick recap from the demo:
- Use case: real-time customer support triage + guided responses for the collections team.
- Key constraints: <10% FTR latency target at 95th percentile, on-prem data requirements for PII redaction, and integration with your Kafka event bus for streaming prompts.
- Dataset: subset of anonymized historical transcripts (approx. 10k rows) you mentioned in the call.

Proposed POC: 4-week technical evaluation (timeline below) focused on the following success criteria:
1) Latency & throughput: achieve <= 300ms P95 for single-turn prompts under a 5 RPS sustained load (Redwood Dedicated config).
2) Quality: automated evals + manual review show no more than 8% regression on your current response accuracy metric (evaluation checklist attached).
3) Integration: end-to-end pipeline ingest from your Kafka topic into the Redwood runtime and back to your CRM (proof of concept connector).
4) Security/compliance: confirm KMS integration and audit log access for the trial environment.

Proposed timeline / ownership:
- Week 0 (this week): agree on scope, sign simple POC addendum, share anonymized sample dataset (Samir/Priya).
- Week 1: infra & connectivity — Redwood sets up a private trial environment, we provision a Dedicated test pool. (Owner: Redwood - Dev Patel)
- Week 2: integration & baseline tests — connector to Kafka + initial model tuning. (Owners: FinServCorp eng + Dev Patel)
- Week 3: focused evaluation — run traffic, collect metrics, manual QA sessions with your SMEs. (Owners: FinServCorp SMEs + Laura Bennett)
- Week 4: wrap & decision — deliver evaluation report, recommended next steps.

Next steps
1) Can you confirm the dataset delivery timeline (we need sample data and a contact to provision access)?
2) Are there any procurement or legal steps we should accelerate (POC addendum, NDAs)?
3) Are you open to a technical sync Wed or Thu this week for the integration plan (30 minutes)?

Attachments: redwood_poc_plan.pdf, evaluation_checklist.xlsx

Thanks again — excited to partner on this.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0174
From: Samir Gupta <samir.g@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finservcorp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear plan and the checklist. A few quick clarifying Qs from our side before we lock dates:

1) Data access: the dataset we can provide is anonymized CSV exports currently stored in an S3 bucket in our AWS account. Will Redwood need a full copy in your environment, or can you pull via a temporary presigned URL? Also, we have strict retention rules — we want to ensure any trial copies are deleted after the POC.

2) On the Dedicated test pool: is that fully hosted by Redwood (we don't want to spin up our own infra), and can you confirm encryption at rest and the KMS options?

3) Timeline: our compliance lead is out next week (Aug 16–20). Ideally we start the week after (Aug 23). Is that workable?

4) Cost / agreement: who signs the POC addendum and is there a fee for the Dedicated trial?

If we can get answers to the above, I'll confirm with Priya and our security/compliance folks.

Best,
Samir
Head of Digital Channels, FinServCorp
samir.g@finservcorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finservcorp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Hi Samir — thanks for the questions, answers inline below.

1) Data access: presigned URL is fine for the sample dataset. We'll download into the trial environment and will confirm deletion after the POC. We'll document the exact retention steps in the addendum. Please share the intended S3 path or a single presigned link and an on-call contact for the handoff.

2) Dedicated test pool: yes — fully hosted by Redwood in a customer-isolated pool (we manage the infra). We support AES-256 encryption at rest and can integrate with your KMS (AWS KMS or a customer-managed key). I'll have our security engineer add a short checklist for the compliance review.

3) Timeline: Aug 23 start works for us. Suggested update to the plan: shift all week numbers + align the wrap on Sep 17 (4-week window starting Aug 23).

4) Cost / agreement: POC addendum is a simple one-page MSA addendum — usually signed by the procurement contact on your side and countersigned by Redwood's legal. For a Dedicated trial there is a nominal trial fee to cover reserved pool capacity; I'll get exact numbers from RevOps and include them in the addendum draft.

Proposed next call: Wed Aug 11 at 10:00am PT for a 30-minute technical sync (Dev + your eng lead) to go over the Kafka connector and data handoff. Does that work for Priya?

I'll attach the minimal security checklist in a follow-up once Dev confirms a couple of details.

Best,
Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Marissa / Laura —

Quick internal note: I reviewed the proposed POC requirements. For the Kafka connector we'll deliver a lightweight consumer that publishes request/response pairs back to a FinServCorp topic. Estimated time to deliver connector + baseline tuning: 6 business days once we have the sample dataset and network connectivity (VPC peering or temporary presigned uploads).

Security checklist items I'll add to the small doc:
- KMS integration options (AWS KMS/customer-managed)
- Retention & deletion confirmation steps for S3 artifacts
- Access controls for trial dashboard (role-based access)

I'll be on the sync Wed Aug 11 at 10:00am PT. I'll also create a short runbook for teardown after the POC.

—Dev
